The '''Farlax sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], near the border of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It contained the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].

==History==
Together, the Farlax and [[Hatawa sector/Legends|Hatawa]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] contained more than 200 inhabited worlds, a third of which were affiliated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Another third were uninhabited or unclaimed.<ref name="CSWE-Farlax sector" />

Despite its relative proximity to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Farlax sector was mostly unexplored by New Republic surveyors after the departure of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
